left.raw_text: Diagnosis of emphysema confirmed by CT scan.
If a report of past CT scan is not available at site documenting then a CT scan is to be performed at screening

right.raw_text: or female patients at least 18 years of age.

left.raw_text: Able and willing to sign an informed consent.
Patient with record of congenital AAT deficiency of phenotype PiZZ (homozygote) or other rare phenotypes related to AAT deficiency and with AAT serum level ≤ 11 micromole.
For patients receiving IV AAT augmentation therapy the serum AAT level threshold does not apply.
FEV1/SVC <70% of predicted value post bronchodilator (SVC is slow VC) and FEV1 < 80% of predicted value post-bronchodilator

History of at least two moderate or severe exacerbations that required change in treatment (antibiotics, systemic steroids, hospitalization) in the last 18 months prior to date of screening, with at least one of these occurring within the last 12 months prior to screening.
Ability to comply with completion of electronic diary.
